run_migrate_checkpoint_cli: run the migrate_checkpoint CLI to convert an OCP checkpoint to fm_release format with --checkpoint-in and --checkpoint-out
run_migrate_checkpoint_add_stress: run the migrate_checkpoint CLI with --add-stress to automatically add stress tasks for datasets missing them
call_migrate_checkpoint: call migrate_checkpoint to load a checkpoint, update module imports, and optionally remove static keys
call_update_config: call update_config to recursively replace old module paths with new ones in a nested dict or OmegaConf config
call_find_new_module_name: call find_new_module_name to resolve an old module path to its new name using the migrate_imports mapping
